description: A Kotlin class GoalsFragment that extends DialogFragment to display and edit user fitness goals via a dialog UI. It interacts with a MockRepository to fetch and update the goals, displaying current values and saving updates.

classes.name: GoalsFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for editing user fitness goals, utilizing Android's AlertDialog and data binding.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog that allows the user to view and modify their fitness goals. It initializes the UI with current goal data, updates the goal on positive button click, or cancels.
